verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud, so first-party background automations (scheduled or triggered workflows) are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such feature. The Cloud API, cloud-init launch scripts and Managed Slurm's workload scheduler are building blocks or adjacent compute-queueing features, not a way to set up autonomous automations. The agent tooling in the pack is an unofficial third-party CLI/MCP server, which does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
